gloss: yellow autumn leaves; leaves turning yellow

definitions.gloss: yellow autumn leaves; leaves turning yellow in autumn
definitions.explanation: The phenomenon of tree leaves turning yellow in autumn, or the yellow leaves themselves. Distinguished from the more general kouyou ({紅葉|こうよう}, red leaves) by specifically referring to yellow coloration, as seen in ginkgo and birch trees.

examples.japanese: イチョウの{黄葉|こうよう}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The yellow autumn leaves of the ginkgo are beautiful.

examples.japanese: {黄葉|こうよう}した{並木道|なみきみち}を{散歩|さんぽ}する。
examples.english: To take a walk along a tree-lined avenue with yellow autumn leaves.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると、{紅葉|こうよう}と{黄葉|こうよう}が{山|やま}を{彩|いろど}り、{多|おお}くの{観光客|かんこうきゃく}が{訪|おとず}れる。
examples.english: In autumn, red and yellow leaves color the mountains, and many tourists visit.

notes:
Written with {黄|こう} (yellow) + {葉|よう} (leaf), in contrast to {紅葉|こうよう} which uses {紅|こう} (crimson). Both are read こうよう, and in everyday speech {紅葉|こうよう} is often used as a general term for all autumn foliage including yellow leaves. {黄葉|こうよう} is used when specifically distinguishing yellow coloration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黄葉|こうよう}する: to turn yellow (of leaves)
- {黄葉|こうよう}が{見頃|みごろ}: the yellow leaves are at their peak
- イチョウの{黄葉|こうよう}: ginkgo yellow leaves
- {紅葉|こうよう}と{黄葉|こうよう}: red and yellow autumn leaves

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {紅葉|こうよう}: autumn leaves (red) — the general term for autumn foliage; homophone
- {落葉|らくよう}: fallen leaves — leaves that have already fallen from the tree
- {新緑|しんりょく}: fresh green leaves — the spring equivalent: new green foliage

USAGE:
The representative tree for {黄葉|こうよう} is the イチョウ (ginkgo), whose brilliant golden leaves are iconic in Japanese autumn scenery. The ginkgo-lined avenue at {明治神宮外苑|めいじじんぐうがいえん} in Tokyo is one of the most famous {黄葉|こうよう} spots in Japan.
